text: Yes, I would perform rifampicin drug-resistance testing on this patient's initial diagnostic specimen. The patient's M. tuberculosis strain has been confirmed to be resistant to rifampicin, isoniazid, and fluoroquinolones, which is pre-XDR-TB. However, retesting the initial specimen for rifampicin resistance can help confirm the accuracy of the initial test results and ensure that the resistance pattern is not due to a laboratory error.
